long_biography.plain_text:
Brian L. Pecheles joined his parents' Volkswagen dealership in Greenville, North Carolina, in 1981 after graduating from the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill. Joe and Elma Pecheles had founded the business sixteen years earlier, giving him an established family platform. He became president in 1983 and led its expansion beyond the original Volkswagen store.

Pecheles Automotive Group added Audi and Hyundai operations in Greenville, Ford and Toyota dealerships in Washington, and a Honda dealership in New Bern. The resulting six-dealership network remains family owned and serves communities across eastern North Carolina. Pecheles has also supported regional education, including automotive training and health-sciences scholarships.
